description: Find the passages in a notebook’s sources that match a query, ranked best first. RPC-backed (no browser). This is retrieval, not an answer: nothing is generated, no generation quota is spent, and you get the indexed text with its offsets. Prefer this over ask_question when you want the evidence rather than the prose, and when you intend to reason over the passages yourself.

limit.description: Keep at most this many passages, best rank first. Omit to get them all.

query.description: What to look for in the sources.

source_ids.description: Restrict the search to these source UUIDs. Omit to search them all.

source_names.description: Restrict the search to sources matched by title (alternative to source_ids). An ambiguous title is an error naming the candidates, never a silent guess.

name: search_passages

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
